name: French's Classic Yellow Mustard (Smooth Stone-Ground)
whyItWorks: Made from finely milled #1 grade mustard seeds, distilled vinegar, water, salt, and turmeric. The seeds are stone-ground into a silky paste with zero whole seeds or abrasive grit, and natural turmeric provides gentle curcumin.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Squirt 1–2 teaspoons onto roasted chicken breast, turkey sandwiches, or soft pretzel sticks.
watchOuts: Contains distilled vinegar; if you have severe active stomach ulcers, use sparingly.
